text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Cancer with Malignant Ascites and Pleural Effusion. The patient's presentation of a large ovarian mass, shortness of breath, and increased abdominal girth is highly suggestive of advanced ovarian malignancy, which explains the fluid accumulation (ascites) compressing the lungs.
